name: autophagy related 2B

function.text: ATG2B encodes autophagy-related protein 2 homolog B. Annotated molecular activities include lipid transfer activity and protein-membrane adaptor activity. It participates in glycophagy and pexophagy.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.
